parts.name: Cabinet Frame
parts.Basic_description: The cabinet frame is the main structural body of the storage cabinet, made of plywood panels forming the sides, back, and top support.
parts.Functional_description: It provides structural integrity and supports all other parts such as shelves, base, and doors.
parts.Movement_description: It is a fixed, non-moving part that holds the entire cabinet together.

parts.name: Cabinet Base
parts.Basic_description: The cabinet base is the bottom platform of the cabinet, made of plywood, supporting the weight of the structure and stored items.
parts.Functional_description: It distributes the load evenly and provides stability to the cabinet.
parts.Movement_description: It is a stationary part that does not move during normal use.

parts.name: Shelf (Upper)
parts.Basic_description: The upper shelf is a horizontal plywood panel inside the cabinet used for organizing and supporting stored items.
parts.Functional_description: It provides a surface for placing items within the cabinet.
parts.Movement_description: It is typically fixed or adjustable but not designed for frequent movement.

parts.name: Shelf (Lower)
parts.Basic_description: The lower shelf is another horizontal plywood panel inside the cabinet, positioned below the upper shelf.
parts.Functional_description: It supports additional storage and helps organize items within the cabinet.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed or adjustable but not intended for regular movement.

parts.name: Cabinet Door (Left)
parts.Basic_description: The left cabinet door is a vertical plywood panel attached to the frame with hinges, featuring a handle for opening.
parts.Functional_description: It allows access to the interior of the cabinet and protects stored items from dust and view.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates about its hinges to open and close.

parts.name: Cabinet Door (Right)
parts.Basic_description: The right cabinet door is a vertical plywood panel attached to the frame with hinges, featuring a handle for opening.
parts.Functional_description: It provides access to the cabinet’s right compartment and protects stored items.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates about its hinges to open and close.
